image_description: A medium shot of a smiling woman with blonde curly hair and glasses, wearing an academic gown with green and black panels and striped sleeves. She is also wearing a maroon velvet hood. The background consists of beige curtains with blue vertical stripes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/chest level; the lower half of the garment and ankles are not visible.
The visible portion of the gown shows clear bilateral symmetry in the sleeve patterns and hood placement, with a central vertical division consistent with a front opening.
The fabric drapes loosely over the shoulders and arms, successfully hiding the underlying body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject's hands are holding an object (likely a diploma) near the chest, and the frame cuts off before the full length of the sleeve extensions can be verified.
Distinct vertical panels of dark fabric are visible on the front of the gown, characteristic of academic regalia closures.
A white collared shirt is clearly visible at the neckline beneath the gown and hood.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black/green fabric exhibits low specular reflection, consistent with heavy matte materials like wool or polyester blends used in gowns.
Aside from the velvet hood which has a slight sheen, the main gown fabric appears smooth and non-reflective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wrists and the ends of the sleeves are outside the frame or obscured by the subject's pose.

The fingers gripping the blue/white object are indistinct and appear to merge with the object. The anatomy of the hand is ambiguous, with unclear finger separation and potential fusion artifacts.
The hanging tassel and the curtain folds show slight inconsistencies in perspective and gravity alignment, appearing somewhat stiff or unnaturally aligned.
